name: FRESH COCONUT CAKE
ingredients:
1  box white cake mix
1  can cream of coconut
1  can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
1  (8 oz.) container Cool Whip
1  (8 oz.) bag fresh coconut
preparation: Bake cake as directed on box.  As soon as cake is out of the oven, poke holes all over the cake with handle of a small wooden spoon.  Immediately pour cream of coconut over the cake evenly, then pour Eagle Brand milk over the cake evenly.  Refrigerate until cold.  Spread Cool Whip evenly and sprinkle with fresh coconut.  Keep in refrigerator.  Makes a 9 x 13-inch cake.

name: CLASSIC RED LENTIL SOUP
ingredients:
1 cup red lentils
1 onion (chopped)
1 carrot (grated)
1 potato (diced)
6 cups hot water
2 tbsp butter
1 tsp salt
1/2 tsp cumin
preparation: Rinse the lentils. In a large pot, sauté the onion, carrot, and potato with butter for 5 minutes. Add the lentils and hot water. Simmer until all vegetables are soft. Blend the soup until smooth. Add salt and cumin. Serve with a squeeze of lemon and a dash of chili flakes.

name: HEARTY WHITE BEAN STEW
ingredients:
2 cups dried white beans (soaked overnight)
1 onion (chopped)
1 tbsp tomato paste
1/2 lb beef or lamb cubes (optional)
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp salt
1/2 tsp red pepper flakes
preparation: Boil the soaked beans until slightly tender and drain. In a pot, sauté onions (and meat if using) in olive oil. Stir in tomato paste. Add the pre-cooked beans and enough hot water to cover. Simmer on low heat until the beans are creamy. Add salt and pepper flakes before serving.

name: CREAMY MUSHROOM CHICKEN
ingredients:
2 chicken breasts (sliced)
1 cup mushrooms (sliced)
1 cup heavy cream
2 cloves garlic (minced)
2 tbsp olive oil
Salt and black pepper
Fresh parsley
preparation: Heat oil in a large skillet. Add chicken and cook until golden brown. Remove chicken and in the same pan, sauté mushrooms and garlic. Pour in the heavy cream and bring to a light simmer. Return the chicken to the pan. Cook until the sauce thickens. Season with salt and pepper. Garnish with parsley.

name: CLASSIC TOMATO SOUP
ingredients:
4 large tomatoes
2 tbsp flour
1 tbsp tomato paste
2 tbsp butter
1 cup milk
4 cups water
Salt
preparation: Melt butter and whisk in flour. Add tomato paste, then grated tomatoes. Add water and simmer. Blend until smooth, add milk and salt. Serve with grated cheddar.

name: CREAMY MUSHROOM SOUP
ingredients:
300g mushrooms (sliced)
1 onion
2 tbsp flour
1 cup heavy cream
4 cups water
3 tbsp oil
preparation: Sauté onions and mushrooms. Whisk in flour, add water and simmer. Pour in cream, salt, and pepper. Boil for 2 minutes and serve.

name: TRADITIONAL TARHANA SOUP
ingredients:
3 tbsp tarhana
1 tbsp tomato paste
1 tbsp butter
1 clove garlic
5 cups water
Dried mint
preparation: Dissolve tarhana in 1 cup water. Melt butter with tomato paste and garlic. Add remaining water and tarhana mix. Stir constantly until it boils.

name: CLASSIC RED LENTIL SOUP
ingredients:
1 cup red lentils
1 onion
1 carrot
1 potato
6 cups water
Salt
Cumin
preparation: Boil all ingredients until soft. Blend until smooth. Sauté butter with chili flakes and pour over the soup.

name: TURKISH WHITE BEAN STEW
ingredients:
2 cups white beans (soaked)
1 onion
1 tbsp tomato paste
100g beef cubes
3 tbsp oil
Salt
preparation: Sauté meat and onions. Add tomato paste and beans. Cover with hot water and simmer until beans are creamy.

name: TRADITIONAL CHICKPEA STEW
ingredients:
2 cups chickpeas (soaked)
1 onion
1 tbsp pepper paste
3 tbsp olive oil
Salt
Red pepper flakes
preparation: Cook onions and paste in oil. Add chickpeas and hot water. Pressure cook or simmer until tender.

name: BULGUR PILAF WITH VEGETABLES
ingredients:
2 cups coarse bulgur
1 onion
2 tomatoes
2 green peppers
3 cups hot water
2 tbsp butter
preparation: Sauté onion and peppers. Add grated tomatoes and bulgur. Pour in water and salt. Cook until water is absorbed and rest for 15 mins.

name: STUFFED BELL PEPPERS
ingredients:
10 bell peppers
1 cup rice
200g ground beef
1 onion
Parsley
Tomato paste
Spices
preparation: Mix rice, meat, chopped onion, and spices. Fill peppers. Place in a pot with tomato paste water. Simmer until rice is cooked.

name: TRADITIONAL STUFFED GRAPE LEAVES
ingredients:
500g grape leaves
1.5 cups rice
2 onions
Olive oil
Dried mint
Lemon
preparation: Sauté onions with rice and spices. Wrap a teaspoon of filling in each leaf. Line in a pot, add water, olive oil, and lemon. Simmer on low heat.

name: STUFFED EGGPLANT (KARNIYARIK)
ingredients:
6 eggplants
250g ground beef
2 onions
2 tomatoes
3 green peppers
Garlic
preparation: Fry eggplants lightly and slit the middle. Sauté meat, onions, and tomatoes for the filling. Stuff eggplants and bake with tomato sauce.

name: VEGETABLE FRIED MEDLEY
ingredients:
2 eggplants
2 zucchinis
3 potatoes
5 green peppers
Oil for frying
Tomato & garlic sauce
preparation: Chop and fry all vegetables. Drain on paper towels. Top with a cooked sauce of grated tomatoes and garlic.

name: TRADITIONAL BEEF YAHNI
ingredients:
500g beef cubes
15 pearl onions
3 cloves garlic
1 tbsp vinegar
1 tbsp tomato paste
Butter
preparation: Seal meat in butter. Add onions, garlic, paste, and vinegar. Cover with little water and slow cook until meat is tender.

name: EGGPLANT AND MEAT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3 eggplants
300g lamb cubes
2 tomatoes
1 onion
Green peppers
Olive oil
preparation: Layer sautéed meat and cubed eggplants in a pot. Add sliced tomatoes and peppers. Pour a little tomato sauce and cook on low heat.

name: PAN-SEARED ANCHOVIES
ingredients:
500g anchovies (cleaned)
1 cup cornmeal
Salt
Oil
preparation: Coat anchovies in salted cornmeal. Arrange in a circular pattern in a greased pan. Fry until crispy, flip using a lid, and fry the other side.

name: BAKED SEABASS WITH VEGETABLES
ingredients:
2 whole fish
1 onion
1 potato
1 lemon
Bay leaves
Olive oil
preparation: Place fish on a baking tray. Surround with sliced onions, potatoes, and lemons. Drizzle olive oil and bake at 200C for 30 mins.

name: CLASSIC MENEMEN
ingredients:
3 eggs
3 green peppers
2 tomatoes
2 tbsp oil
Salt
Pepper flakes
preparation: Sauté chopped peppers. Add grated tomatoes and cook until juice reduces. Crack eggs, season, and stir gently until set.

name: CRISPY CHICKEN WINGS
ingredients:
1 kg chicken wings
2 tbsp yogurt
1 tbsp tomato paste
2 cloves garlic
Thyme
Chili flakes
preparation: Marinate wings in yogurt, paste, garlic, and spices for 1 hour. Fry in a pan or bake until golden and crispy.

name: PASTA WITH TOMATO SAUCE
ingredients:
1 pack pasta
2 tbsp tomato paste
2 tbsp butter
Dried mint
Garlic
preparation: Boil pasta and drain. In the same pot, melt butter with paste, garlic, and mint. Toss pasta back in and mix well.

name: HOME-STYLE BEEF KEBAB
ingredients:
500g beef strips
1 onion
2 peppers
Cumin
Thyme
Butter
Lavaish bread
preparation: Sauté meat in a hot pan until juices are absorbed. Add butter, sliced onions, and peppers. Serve on lavaish with spices.

name: TURKISH TRAY BOREK
ingredients:
5 sheets phyllo (yufka)
3 eggs
1 cup milk
1 cup oil
Cheese or Spinach filling
preparation: Whisk eggs, milk, and oil. Layer phyllo sheets in a tray, brushing each with the liquid. Place filling in the middle. Bake at 180C.

name: WATER BOREK STYLE
ingredients:
6 sheets phyllo
1 cup milk
1 cup sparkling water
200g feta cheese
Parsley
preparation: Soak phyllo layers in a mix of milk and sparkling water. Layer with cheese and parsley. Bake until the top is very golden and soft.

name: POTATO AND CHEESE BOREK
ingredients:
4 sheets phyllo
3 boiled potatoes
1 cup grated cheddar
Onion
Paprika
preparation: Sauté onions with mashed potatoes and spices. Fill phyllo rolls with potato and cheese. Brush with egg yolk and bake.

name: SPINACH AND FETA BOREK
ingredients:
5 sheets phyllo
500g spinach
1 onion
1 cup feta cheese
Red pepper flakes
preparation: Sauté spinach with onions. Mix with feta. Fill phyllo sheets, roll into a spiral, and bake until crispy.

name: SOFT BREAKFAST POGACA
ingredients:
1 cup warm milk
1 cup oil
1 tbsp yeast
2 tbsp sugar
4 cups flour
Egg yolk
preparation: Knead a soft dough with ingredients. Let rise for 1 hour. Shape into rolls, add cheese filling, brush with egg yolk, and bake.

name: TRADITIONAL SESAME COREK
ingredients:
500g flour
1 cup milk
100g butter
1 tbsp mahlep
Sesame seeds
Nigella seeds
preparation: Mix ingredients to form a dough. Shape into braids or rounds. Sprinkle with sesame and nigella seeds. Bake until fragrant.

name: EASY TIRAMISU
ingredients:
1 pack cat's tongue biscuits
2 cups coffee
250g mascarpone
2 eggs
1/2 cup sugar
Cocoa powder
preparation: Dip biscuits in coffee and layer. Mix mascarpone, egg yolks, and sugar. Spread over biscuits. Repeat layers and dust with cocoa.

name: TRADITIONAL WALNUT BAKLAVA
ingredients:
1 pack baklava phyllo
250g butter
2 cups walnuts
Syrup: 3 cups sugar, 3 cups water, lemon
preparation: Layer 40 sheets of phyllo, brushing each with melted butter. Place walnuts in the middle. Cut into diamonds and bake. Pour cold syrup over hot baklava.

name: FRIED VEGETABLES WITH YOGURT
ingredients:
2 potatoes
2 eggplants
3 peppers
Garlic yogurt sauce
Tomato sauce
preparation: Fry chopped vegetables separately. Layer on a plate. Top with garlic yogurt and then warm tomato sauce.

name: TRADITIONAL TURKISH MEATBALLS
ingredients:
500g ground beef
1 onion
1 egg
1/2 cup breadcrumbs
Cumin
Parsley
preparation: Knead all ingredients for 10 minutes. Shape into small ovals. Fry in a lightly oiled pan or grill until cooked through.

name: RICE PILAF WITH ORZO
ingredients:
2 cups rice
3 tbsp orzo (sehriye)
3 cups hot water
2 tbsp butter
Salt
preparation: Brown the orzo in butter. Add soaked rice and sauté for 2 mins. Add water and salt. Cook on low heat until water is absorbed.

name: TRADITIONAL TURKISH MEATBALLS (ANNE KOFTE)
ingredients:
1 lb ground beef
1 onion (grated)
1 egg
1/2 cup breadcrumbs
2 cloves garlic
1 tsp cumin
1 tsp black pepper
Fresh parsley
preparation: In a large bowl, combine ground beef, grated onion, garlic, egg, and breadcrumbs. Add spices and finely chopped parsley. Knead the mixture for at least 10 minutes. Shape into small ovals. Grill or fry in a lightly oiled pan until both sides are browned and cooked through.

name: CLASSIC CHICKEN SAUTE
ingredients:
2 lbs chicken breast (cubed)
2 green peppers
1 red pepper
1 onion
2 tomatoes
1 tbsp tomato paste
3 tbsp olive oil
Thyme and red pepper flakes
preparation: Heat olive oil in a large pan. Sauté the chicken until it releases and reabsorbs its juices. Add chopped onions and peppers, cook for 5 minutes. Stir in tomato paste and diced tomatoes. Season with thyme, salt, and pepper flakes. Cover and simmer on low heat for 15 minutes.

name: OVEN-BAKED POTATOES WITH LAMB
ingredients:
1 lb lamb cubes
4 large potatoes
2 tomatoes
2 green peppers
1 tbsp butter
1 tbsp tomato paste
1 cup hot water
preparation: Peel and cube the potatoes. Place lamb and potatoes in a baking dish. Add sliced tomatoes and peppers on top. Mix tomato paste with hot water and pour over the ingredients. Add small pieces of butter. Cover with foil and bake at 200C for 45 minutes, then remove foil and brown for 15 more minutes.

name: TRADITIONAL GREEN BEANS WITH OLIVE OIL
ingredients:
2 lbs fresh green beans
1 onion (chopped)
2 tomatoes (grated)
1/2 cup olive oil
1 tsp sugar
1 tsp salt
1/2 cup hot water
preparation: Clean and trim the green beans. In a pot, sauté onions in olive oil until translucent. Add the beans and cook for 5 minutes. Stir in grated tomatoes, sugar, and salt. Add hot water. Cover and simmer on low heat until the beans are tender and the water is reduced.

name: CLASSIC CHEESE OMELET
ingredients:
3 eggs
1/2 cup shredded cheddar or feta cheese
1 tbsp butter
Salt and pepper
Optional: Fresh parsley
preparation: Whisk the eggs with salt and pepper in a bowl. Melt butter in a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Pour in the eggs. As they set, lift the edges to let uncooked egg flow underneath. Sprinkle cheese over one half, fold the omelet, and cook for another minute until cheese melts.

name: HOMEMADE HAMBURGER PATTY
ingredients:
1 lb ground beef (20% fat)
1 tsp salt
1 tsp black pepper
1 tsp garlic powder
1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce (optional)
preparation: Gently mix the ground beef with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and sauce. Do not overwork the meat. Shape into 4 thick patties. Make a small indentation in the center of each. Grill or pan-fry for 4-5 minutes per side. Serve in toasted buns with your favorite toppings.

name: SPAGHETTI BOLOGNESE
ingredients:
1 lb spaghetti
1/2 lb ground beef
1 onion
2 cloves garlic
1 can tomato puree
1 tsp dried oregano
Olive oil
preparation: Cook spaghetti according to package directions. In a pan, sauté onion and garlic in olive oil. Add ground beef and brown it. Pour in tomato puree and oregano. Simmer for 10 minutes. Toss the sauce with the pasta and serve with parmesan cheese.

name: CLASSIC CAESAR SALAD
ingredients:
2 heads romaine lettuce
1/2 cup croutons
1/4 cup parmesan cheese
Dressing: 3 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp lemon juice, 1 tsp Dijon mustard, 1 minced garlic clove
preparation: Chop the lettuce into bite-sized pieces and place in a large bowl. In a small jar, whisk together the oil, lemon juice, mustard, and garlic. Pour the dressing over the lettuce. Add croutons and shaved parmesan cheese. Toss gently and serve immediately.

name: CREAMY FETTUCCINE ALFREDO
ingredients:
1 lb fettuccine pasta
1 cup heavy cream
1/2 cup butter
1 cup grated parmesan cheese
2 cloves garlic
Fresh parsley
preparation: Boil pasta in salted water. In a saucepan, melt butter and sauté minced garlic. Add heavy cream and bring to a simmer. Stir in parmesan cheese until melted and smooth. Toss the cooked pasta in the sauce. Garnish with chopped parsley.

name: TRADITIONAL LENTIL PATTIES (MERCIMEK KOFTE)
ingredients:
1 cup red lentils
1.5 cups fine bulgur
1 onion
1/2 cup olive oil
2 tbsp tomato & pepper paste
Green onions and parsley
Spices: Cumin, salt, chili flakes
preparation: Boil lentils in 3 cups of water until soft. Stir in bulgur, cover, and let it sit for 20 mins. Sauté onions in oil with paste and add to the mix. Add chopped greens and spices. Knead well and shape into small patties. Serve with lettuce and lemon.

name: BAKED MACARONI AND CHEESE
ingredients:
1 lb macaroni
2 cups shredded cheddar cheese
2 cups milk
2 tbsp butter
2 tbsp flour
Breadcrumbs for topping
preparation: Cook macaroni. Make a roux by melting butter and whisking in flour, then slowly add milk until thickened. Stir in 1.5 cups of cheese. Mix sauce with macaroni and pour into a baking dish. Top with remaining cheese and breadcrumbs. Bake at 180C for 20 minutes.

name: BEEF AND BROCCOLI STIR-FRY
ingredients:
1 lb beef strips
2 cups broccoli florets
3 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp ginger (minced)
2 cloves garlic
1 tbsp honey
preparation: Sear beef strips in a hot wok until browned. Remove beef. Sauté broccoli with a splash of water until tender-crisp. Return beef to the pan. Mix soy sauce, ginger, garlic, and honey, then pour over. Toss for 2 minutes and serve over rice.

name: STUFFED ZUCCHINI (KABAK DOLMASI)
ingredients:
4 medium zucchinis
1 cup rice
200g ground beef
1 tbsp tomato paste
Fresh dill
Dried mint
Olive oil
preparation: Hollow out the zucchinis. Mix rice, beef, paste, chopped dill, and spices. Fill the zucchinis with the mixture. Place upright in a pot. Add water mixed with a little tomato paste and oil. Cover and simmer until zucchinis are soft.

name: CLASSIC PANCAKES
ingredients:
1.5 cups flour
1 cup milk
1 egg
2 tbsp melted butter
2 tbsp sugar
1 tbsp baking powder
1 tsp vanilla
preparation: Whisk the egg, milk, and melted butter. In a separate bowl, mix dry ingredients. Combine wet and dry ingredients until just blended. Pour small amounts onto a hot, greased griddle. Flip when bubbles form on top. Serve with syrup or honey.

name: CHICKEN NOODLE SOUP
ingredients:
1 lb chicken breast
1 cup egg noodles
2 carrots (sliced)
2 celery stalks
1 onion
8 cups chicken broth
Thyme
preparation: In a large pot, simmer chicken broth with chopped onions, carrots, and celery. Add chicken and cook until tender, then shred it. Add noodles and cook until soft. Return shredded chicken to the pot. Season with salt, pepper, and thyme.

name: TRADITIONAL SPINACH PIE (ISPANAKLI BOREK)
ingredients:
5 sheets phyllo dough
1 lb fresh spinach
1 onion
1 cup feta cheese
Liquid mix: 1 cup milk, 1/2 cup yogurt, 2 eggs, 1/2 cup oil
preparation: Sauté onions and spinach until wilted. Mix with crumbled feta. Whisk the liquid ingredients. Layer phyllo in a tray, brushing each sheet with the liquid mix. Spread spinach in the middle. Top with remaining sheets. Bake at 190C until golden brown.

name: ROASTED WHOLE CHICKEN
ingredients:
1 whole chicken
2 tbsp butter
1 lemon
4 cloves garlic
Fresh rosemary and thyme
Salt and pepper
preparation: Rub the chicken with butter, salt, and pepper. Stuff the cavity with lemon halves, garlic, and herbs. Tie the legs with kitchen twine. Bake at 200C for about 1 hour and 15 minutes, basting occasionally with pan juices, until the skin is crispy and golden.

name: QUICK MARGHERITA PIZZA
ingredients:
1 pizza dough
1/2 cup tomato sauce
1 cup fresh mozzarella
Fresh basil leaves
Olive oil
preparation: Roll out the dough. Spread tomato sauce evenly. Top with slices of mozzarella. Bake at 250C (or highest setting) for 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven, add fresh basil leaves, and drizzle with olive oil.

name: TRADITIONAL RICE PUDDING (SUTLAC)
ingredients:
1/2 cup rice
1 quart milk
1 cup sugar
1 tbsp rice flour or cornstarch
1 tsp vanilla
Cinnamon for garnish
preparation: Boil rice in 2 cups of water until very soft. Add milk and sugar, bring to a boil. Dissolve starch in a little water and stir into the pot. Simmer until thickened. Add vanilla. Pour into bowls and chill. Sprinkle with cinnamon before serving.

name: EASY SHAKSHUKA
ingredients:
4 eggs
1 can diced tomatoes
1 onion
1 red bell pepper
2 cloves garlic
1 tsp cumin
1 tsp paprika
preparation: Sauté onion, pepper, and garlic until soft. Add tomatoes and spices. Simmer for 10 minutes until sauce thickens. Use a spoon to make small wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each. Cover and cook until egg whites are set but yolks are still runny.

name: MUSHROOM SOUP
ingredients:
300g mushrooms
1 onion
2 tbsp flour
1 cup heavy cream
4 cups water
3 tbsp oil
Salt
preparation: Sauté onions and sliced mushrooms. Whisk in flour. Add water and simmer. Pour in heavy cream and salt. Stir until it reaches a boil and serve hot.

name: SCRAMBLED EGGS
ingredients:
3 eggs
1 tbsp butter
Salt
Black pepper
preparation: Melt butter in a pan. Whisk eggs and pour into the pan. Stir constantly over low heat until eggs are creamy and set.

name: FRENCH TOAST
ingredients:
4 slices of bread
2 eggs
1/2 cup milk
1 tsp cinnamon
1 tbsp butter
preparation: Whisk eggs, milk, and cinnamon. Dip bread slices into the mixture. Fry in butter on both sides until golden brown.

name: HUMMUS
ingredients:
2 cups chickpeas (cooked)
1/2 cup tahini
2 cloves garlic
Juice of 1 lemon
1/4 cup olive oil
Cumin
preparation: Blend chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, and cumin until smooth. Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with paprika.

name: FALAFEL
ingredients:
2 cups dried chickpeas (soaked)
1 onion
3 cloves garlic
Parsley
1 tsp cumin
Oil for frying
preparation: Blend all ingredients (except oil) into a coarse paste. Shape into balls. Deep fry until golden brown and crispy.

name: FRIED POTATOES
ingredients:
4 potatoes
Oil for frying
Salt
preparation: Peel and slice potatoes into strips. Heat oil in a deep pan. Fry potatoes until golden and crispy. Drain on paper towels and add salt.

name: MASHED POTATOES
ingredients:
4 potatoes
2 tbsp butter
1/2 cup milk
Salt
Black pepper
preparation: Boil potatoes until soft. Drain and mash. Add butter, milk, salt, and pepper. Stir until smooth and creamy.

name: ROASTED VEGETABLES
ingredients:
2 potatoes
2 carrots
1 zucchini
1 red pepper
Olive oil
Thyme
Salt
preparation: Chop all vegetables. Toss with olive oil, salt, and thyme. Spread on a tray and bake at 200C for 30 minutes.

name: ZUCCHINI FRITTERS (MUCVER)
ingredients:
3 zucchinis
2 eggs
1/2 cup flour
Fresh dill
Feta cheese
Oil for frying
preparation: Grate zucchinis and squeeze out water. Mix with eggs, flour, chopped dill, and cheese. Scoop into hot oil and fry both sides until golden.

name: BEEF WITH MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
500g beef strips
300g mushrooms
1 onion
2 tbsp butter
Salt
Black pepper
preparation: Sear beef. Add onions and sliced mushrooms. Cook until water is absorbed. Add butter and spices. Stir for 2 minutes.

name: SALMON WITH ASPARAGUS
ingredients:
2 salmon fillets
1 bunch asparagus
2 tbsp olive oil
1 lemon
Garlic powder
preparation: Place salmon and asparagus on a tray. Drizzle with oil and lemon juice. Season with garlic powder and salt. Bake at 200C for 15 minutes.

name: PASTA WITH PESTO
ingredients:
1 pack pasta
1/2 cup pesto sauce
Parmesan cheese
preparation: Boil pasta and drain. Toss with pesto sauce. Top with grated parmesan cheese and serve immediately.

name: QUESADILLA
ingredients:
2 tortillas
1 cup shredded chicken
1 cup cheese
1 pepper
1 onion
preparation: Sauté onion and pepper. Place one tortilla in a pan, add cheese, chicken, and vegetables. Cover with second tortilla. Grill both sides until cheese melts.

name: TUNA SALAD
ingredients:
1 can tuna
1 head lettuce
1/2 cup corn
Olive oil
Lemon juice
Salt
preparation: Chop lettuce and place in a bowl. Add drained tuna and corn. Drizzle with oil and lemon. Mix gently and serve.

name: BEEF TACOS
ingredients:
6 taco shells
300g ground beef
1 onion
Lettuce
Cheese
Taco seasoning
preparation: Cook beef with taco seasoning. Fill shells with beef. Top with chopped onion, lettuce, and shredded cheese.

name: STIR-FRY CHICKEN
ingredients:
2 chicken breasts
1 broccoli head
2 carrots
3 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp ginger
preparation: Sauté chicken strips. Add sliced carrots and broccoli. Pour in soy sauce and ginger. Stir over high heat for 5 minutes.

name: CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
2 cups flour
1 cup sugar
3 eggs
1/2 cup cocoa
1 cup milk
1/2 cup oil
Baking powder
preparation: Whisk eggs and sugar. Add milk, oil, and dry ingredients. Pour into a greased pan. Bake at 180C for 35 minutes.

name: APPLE PIE
ingredients:
2 pie crusts
5 apples
1/2 cup sugar
1 tsp cinnamon
1 tbsp butter
preparation: Slice apples and mix with sugar and cinnamon. Fill one crust. Top with second crust. Bake at 190C for 45 minutes.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
3 ripe bananas
1.5 cups flour
1/2 cup sugar
1 egg
1/3 cup melted butter
1 tsp baking soda
preparation: Mash bananas. Mix with butter, sugar, and egg. Add flour and baking soda. Bake in a loaf pan at 175C for 1 hour.

name: BROWNIES
ingredients:
1 cup melted butter
2 cups sugar
4 eggs
1 cup flour
3/4 cup cocoa
1 tsp vanilla
preparation: Mix butter and sugar. Add eggs and vanilla. Stir in flour and cocoa. Pour into a square pan. Bake at 175C for 25 minutes.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
2 cups flour
1 cup butter
3/4 cup sugar
1 egg
1 cup chocolate chips
1 tsp vanilla
preparation: Cream butter and sugar. Add egg and vanilla. Stir in flour and chips. Drop spoonfuls onto a tray. Bake at 180C for 10 minutes.

name: LEMONADE
ingredients:
5 lemons
1 cup sugar
6 cups water
Mint leaves
preparation: Squeeze lemons. Mix juice with sugar until dissolved. Add water and stir. Serve chilled with fresh mint leaves.

name: GRILLED STEAK
ingredients:
2 ribeye steaks
2 tbsp olive oil
2 cloves garlic
1 sprig rosemary
Salt and black pepper
preparation: Rub steaks with oil, salt, and pepper. Heat a pan until smoking hot. Sear steaks for 3-4 minutes per side. Add butter, garlic, and rosemary for the last minute, basting the meat.

name: CHICKEN FAJITAS
ingredients:
500g chicken strips
2 bell peppers
1 onion
2 tbsp soy sauce
1 tsp cumin
Oil
preparation: Sauté chicken until golden. Add sliced onions and peppers. Stir in soy sauce and cumin. Cook for 5 minutes and serve with warm tortillas.

name: LENTIL SALAD
ingredients:
1 cup boiled green lentils
1 red pepper
Parsley
Olive oil
Lemon juice
Salt
preparation: Mix boiled lentils with chopped pepper and parsley. Drizzle with oil and lemon juice. Season with salt and serve cold.

name: ZUCCHINI SOUP
ingredients:
3 zucchinis
1 onion
1 cup milk
2 tbsp flour
4 cups water
Fresh dill
Butter
preparation: Sauté onion and zucchinis. Whisk in flour. Add water and boil. Blend until smooth, add milk and chopped dill. Simmer for 2 minutes.

name: BEEF STROGANOFF
ingredients:
500g beef strips
200g mushrooms
1 onion
1/2 cup sour cream
1 tbsp mustard
Butter
preparation: Sauté beef and remove. In the same pan, sauté onion and mushrooms. Stir in sour cream and mustard. Return beef and simmer for 2 mins.

name: STUFFED MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
12 large mushrooms
1/2 cup shredded cheese
1 tbsp butter
Garlic powder
Salt
preparation: Remove stems. Mix chopped stems with butter and garlic. Fill mushroom caps, top with cheese, and bake at 190C for 15 minutes.

name: POTATO KOFTE
ingredients:
3 boiled potatoes
1 egg
1/2 cup flour
1/2 cup cheese
Parsley
Salt
preparation: Mash potatoes and mix with egg, cheese, flour, and parsley. Shape into small patties and fry in oil until golden brown.

name: CHICKEN SCHNITZEL
ingredients:
2 chicken breasts
1 egg
1 cup breadcrumbs
1/2 cup flour
Oil for frying
preparation: Coat chicken in flour, then beaten egg, then breadcrumbs. Fry in hot oil until golden and crispy on both sides.

name: GREEK SALAD
ingredients:
2 tomatoes
1 cucumber
1 red onion
Feta cheese
Kalamata olives
Olive oil

preparation: Marinate and grill chicken. Simmer in a spiced tomato cream sauce. Serve with naan bread.

name: CLAM CHOWDER
ingredients: Clams, potatoes, bacon, onions, heavy cream, clam juice
preparation: Cook bacon and onions. Add potatoes and clam juice. Simmer. Stir in cream and clams.

name: BEEF STEW
ingredients: Beef cubes, potatoes, carrots, celery, beef broth, thyme
preparation: Sear beef. Add vegetables and broth. Simmer for 2 hours until tender.

name: FALAFEL WRAP
ingredients: Falafel balls, pita bread, hummus, lettuce, tomato, tahini sauce
preparation: Warm pita. Spread hummus. Add falafel and salad. Drizzle with tahini and wrap.

name: WALDORF SALAD
ingredients: Apples, grapes, celery, walnuts, mayonnaise, lemon juice
preparation: Chop fruit and celery. Toss with walnuts and mayo-lemon dressing.

name: CHICKEN SOUVLAKI
ingredients: Chicken chunks, lemon juice, olive oil, oregano, pita bread, tzatziki
preparation: Marinate and skewer chicken. Grill until cooked. Serve in pita with tzatziki sauce.

name: PUMPKIN SOUP
ingredients: Pumpkin puree, onion, garlic, vegetable broth, heavy cream, nutmeg
preparation: Sauté onion and garlic. Add pumpkin and broth. Simmer and blend. Add cream and nutmeg.

name: BLUEBERRY PANCAKES
ingredients: Pancake batter, fresh blueberries, butter, maple syrup
preparation: Drop blueberries into pancakes while cooking on the griddle. Serve hot with syrup.

name: CHICKEN NOODLE SOUP
ingredients: Chicken, egg noodles, carrots, celery, onion, chicken broth
preparation: Boil chicken and vegetables in broth. Add noodles and cook until soft. Season with salt and pepper.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients: Flour, butter, sugar, chocolate chips, eggs, vanilla
preparation: Mix ingredients. Drop spoonfuls on a tray. Bake at 180C for 10 minutes.

name: TRADITIONAL ETLI EKMEK (TURKISH MEAT BREAD)
ingredients: Dough (flour, yeast, water), 500g ground beef, 2 onions, 3 green peppers, 2 tomatoes, fresh parsley, salt, black pepper
preparation: Finely mince vegetables and mix with ground beef and spices. Roll out the dough into a very long, thin oval shape. Spread the meat mixture thinly over the dough. Bake in a very hot oven (ideally stone oven) until the edges are crispy and the meat is cooked.

name: HOME-STYLE KOKOREC
ingredients: 500g lamb intestines (cleaned and chopped), 2 green peppers, 1 tomato, 2 tbsp butter, plenty of dried oregano, chili flakes, salt, cumin
preparation: Finely chop the pre-boiled intestines. Sauté in a pan with butter until crispy. Add chopped peppers and tomatoes. Season heavily with oregano, cumin, and chili flakes. Serve chopped inside a toasted half-bread or sandwich roll.

name: TRADITIONAL ISKEMBE CORBASI (TRIPE SOUP)
ingredients: 1 lb cleaned tripe, 2 cloves garlic, 1/2 cup vinegar, 2 tbsp flour, 1 egg yolk, juice of 1 lemon, butter, paprika
preparation: Boil tripe until very tender and dice it. Whisk egg yolk, lemon juice, and flour to create a thickening sauce (terbiye) and slowly add to the broth. Serve with a side of crushed garlic in vinegar and a drizzle of sizzling paprika butter.

name: CLASSIC TURKISH MANTI (DUMPLINGS)
ingredients: Dough sheets, 250g ground beef, 1 grated onion, garlic yogurt, butter, tomato paste, dried mint
preparation: Mix meat and onion for filling. Cut dough into tiny squares, place filling, and pinch corners to close. Boil in salted water. Serve topped with plenty of garlic yogurt and a warm sauce made of butter, tomato paste, and mint.

name: HOMEMADE ERISTE (TURKISH NOODLES)
ingredients: 2 cups sun-dried flour noodles (eriste), 2 tbsp butter, 1/2 cup crushed walnuts, 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese
preparation: Boil noodles in salted water until al dente and drain. Melt butter in a pan and toss the noodles. Serve topped with toasted walnuts and feta cheese for a classic Anatolian comfort meal.

name: SUMMER COLD SOUP (SOGUK AYRAN ASI)
ingredients: 2 cups yogurt, 1 cup boiled wheat, 1/2 cup boiled chickpeas, cold water, fresh mint, fresh dill, salt
preparation: Whisk yogurt with cold water until smooth. Stir in the boiled wheat and chickpeas. Add finely chopped mint and dill. Chill in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours before serving cold.

name: POPPY SEED COREK (HASHAŞLI ÇÖREK)
ingredients: Yeast dough, 1 cup poppy seed paste, 1/2 cup walnuts, 1/2 cup oil, 1 egg yolk (for topping)
preparation: Roll out the dough and spread a mixture of poppy seed paste and oil. Sprinkle crushed walnuts. Roll the dough into a log, twist it, and place in a baking tin. Brush with egg yolk and bake at 180C until golden brown and aromatic.

name: TURKISH LENTIL SOUP (MERCIMEK CORBASI)
ingredients: 1 cup red lentils, 1 onion, 1 carrot, 1 potato, 1 tbsp tomato paste, cumin, butter, lemon wedges
preparation: Boil lentils and vegetables until soft. Blend until completely smooth. Sauté butter with chili flakes for the top. Serve with plenty of lemon juice; a staple in every Turkish household.

name: BEEF TANTUNI (MERSIN STYLE)
ingredients: 500g very finely diced beef, cotton oil, paprika, sumac, onions, parsley, tomatoes, fresh lavaish bread
preparation: Stir-fry beef in a traditional tantuni pan with oil and water. Add paprika for color. Place meat in lavaish, add a salad of onions with sumac, tomatoes, and parsley. Roll tightly and serve with pickles.

name: STUFFED CHARD LEAVES (PAZI SARMASI)
ingredients: 1 bunch chard leaves, 1 cup rice, 200g ground beef, onions, tomato paste, fresh dill, yogurt
preparation: Blanch chard leaves. Mix rice, meat, and herbs. Wrap the filling in leaves. Simmer in a pot with a little water and olive oil. Serve with a side of thick garlic yogurt.

name: TURKISH RICE PUDDING (FIRIN SUTLAC)
ingredients: 1 quart milk, 1/2 cup rice, 1 cup sugar, 1 egg yolk, 1 tbsp cornstarch, vanilla
preparation: Boil rice until soft. Add milk and sugar. Whisk egg yolk and starch with a little milk and add to the pot. Pour into clay bowls and bake in a water bath at 250C until the tops are charred brown.

name: SIMIT (TURKISH SESAME BREAD)
ingredients: 500g flour, yeast, 1 tbsp sugar, 1/2 cup grape molasses (pepmez), 1 cup water, plenty of toasted sesame seeds
preparation: Shape dough into rings. Dip each ring into a mixture of molasses and water, then coat completely in toasted sesame seeds. Bake at 200C until deep golden and very crunchy.

name: LAHMACUN (TURKISH PIZZA)
ingredients: Thin dough, 300g fatty ground beef, tomatoes, garlic, onions, parsley, paprika, lemon
preparation: Pulse vegetables in a processor and mix with meat. Spread a very thin layer on ultra-thin dough circles. Bake quickly in a hot oven. Serve with parsley, sumac onions, and a squeeze of lemon.

name: CIG KOFTE (VEGETARIAN STYLE)
ingredients: 2 cups fine bulgur, 2 tbsp pepper paste, isot (black chili flakes), pomegranate molasses, onions, garlic, fresh greens
preparation: Knead bulgur with paste, garlic, and spices for at least 45 minutes until it softens. Add pomegranate molasses and oil. Shape by hand and serve inside lettuce leaves with lemon.

name: TAS KEBABI (BEEF STEW WITH POTATOES)
ingredients: 500g beef cubes, 2 potatoes, 1 onion, 1 tbsp tomato paste, thyme, salt
preparation: Sear meat and onions. Add tomato paste and hot water; simmer until meat is half-cooked. Add cubed potatoes and cook until everything is tender. A classic 'home cooking' (ev yemegi) favorite.

name: WOMEN'S THIGH MEATBALLS (KADINBUDU KOFTE)
ingredients: 500g ground beef, 1/2 cup boiled rice, 1 onion, 2 eggs, flour (for coating), oil for frying
preparation: Sauté half the meat with onions. Mix with the raw meat and boiled rice. Shape into large ovals. Coat in flour and beaten egg, then fry until golden. Can be served cold or hot.

name: SU BOREGI (WATER BOREK)
ingredients: Handmade dough sheets, 4 eggs, feta cheese, parsley, plenty of butter
preparation: Boil each thin dough sheet in water, then shock in cold water. Layer sheets in a buttered tray with cheese in the middle. Bake until the top is crispy but the inside remains soft and juicy.

name: HUNKAR BEGENDI (SULTAN'S DELIGHT)
ingredients: Lamb cubes, 3 eggplants, 1 cup milk, 1 tbsp flour, 1 cup cheddar cheese, tomato paste
preparation: Cook lamb in a tomato sauce. Roast eggplants and mash them. Make a bechamel with flour, milk, and cheese; stir in the eggplants. Serve the lamb over the creamy eggplant bed.

name: ZUCCHINI MUCVER
ingredients: 3 zucchinis, 2 eggs, 1/2 cup flour, fresh dill, green onions, feta cheese, salt
preparation: Grate zucchinis and squeeze out all water. Mix with eggs, flour, herbs, and cheese. Scoop into hot oil and fry like pancakes. Serve with a side of yogurt.

name: PIYAZ (TURKISH BEAN SALAD)
ingredients: 2 cups boiled white beans, 1 red onion, sumac, parsley, 1 hard-boiled egg, tahini-vinegar dressing
preparation: Mix beans with sliced onions, sumac, and parsley. Drizzle with a special dressing made of tahini, vinegar, and garlic. Top with sliced boiled eggs. Classic side for meatballs.

name: TURKISH TEA CAKE (ANNE KEKİ)
ingredients: 3 eggs, 1 cup sugar, 1 cup yogurt, 1/2 cup oil, 2.5 cups flour, walnuts or raisins
preparation: Whisk eggs and sugar until fluffy. Add yogurt and oil. Fold in flour and walnuts. Bake at 170C. The nostalgic smell of every Turkish afternoon tea time.

name: SPICY BULGUR SALAD (KISIR)
ingredients: 2 cups fine bulgur, tomato paste, pomegranate molasses, green onions, fresh mint, parsley, lemon juice
preparation: Soak bulgur in hot water. Knead with tomato paste. Add plenty of finely chopped greens, lemon juice, and pomegranate molasses. Serve with lettuce leaves.

name: MEFTUNE (DI DIYARBAKIR STYLE STEW)
ingredients: 500g lamb, 3 eggplants, 4 tomatoes, garlic, sumac water
preparation: Layer meat and eggplants in a pot. Add chopped tomatoes and garlic. Pour sumac water over. Simmer until the eggplants are meltingly soft and the sauce is sour and rich.

name: STUFFED QUINCE (AYVA DOLMASI)
ingredients: 3 quinces, 200g ground lamb, 1/2 cup rice, currants, pine nuts, cinnamon, molasses
preparation: Hollow out quinces. Fill with a mixture of meat, rice, and spices. Cook in a sweet and sour sauce made with water and molasses. A magnificent example of Ottoman palace cuisine.

name: TULUMBA DESSERT
ingredients: Fried dough batons, heavy syrup (sugar, water, lemon), oil for frying
preparation: Pipe dough into hot oil using a star-shaped nozzle. Fry until very crispy and dark golden. Immediately drop into cold syrup. A classic Turkish street sweet.

name: ADANA STYLE SIRDAN
ingredients: 3 lamb abomasums (sırdan), 1 cup rice, 100g ground lamb, 1 tbsp pepper paste, cumin, chili flakes, allspice, dry mint
preparation: Thoroughly clean the abomasums. Mix rice, meat, and plenty of spices. Fill the bags but don't overstuff. Sew the openings. Boil in a large pot with pepper paste and spices for 3 hours until tender. Serve with plenty of cumin and lemon.

name: TRADITIONAL MUMBAR DOLMASI
ingredients: Lamb intestines, 1 cup rice, 200g ground beef, 1 onion, tomato paste, dried mint, black pepper, cinnamon
preparation: Clean the intestines with salt and vinegar. Mix the filling and stuff the intestines loosely. Tie the ends. Boil in a seasoned broth until the rice is cooked and the casing is tender. Serve sliced and hot.

name: TURKISH WET CAKE (ISLAK KEK)
ingredients: 3 eggs, 1 cup sugar, 1 cup milk, 1 cup oil, 1/2 cup cocoa, baking powder, Sauce: 1.5 cups milk, 1/2 cup sugar, 2 tbsp cocoa
preparation: Bake the cake. While hot, poke holes and pour the boiled and cooled cocoa-milk sauce over it. Let it soak for 2 hours. The result should be a fudge-like, intensely moist chocolate dessert.

name: STUFFED MELON (OSMANLI SARAY MUTFAĞI)
ingredients: 1 medium melon, 250g ground lamb, 1/2 cup rice, pine nuts, currants, almonds, cinnamon, butter
preparation: Carve out the seeds of the melon. Sauté meat with nuts, fruits, and rice. Stuff the melon and bake in the oven at 180C for 30 minutes. A magnificent example of 15th-century Ottoman 'sweet and savory' contrast.

name: CRISPY LAMB TROTTERS (PACA)
ingredients: 4 lamb trotters, garlic, vinegar, lemon juice, butter, red pepper flakes
preparation: Boil the trotters until the meat falls off the bone. Shred the meat. Serve in its own collagen-rich broth with a heavy sauce of crushed garlic, vinegar, and sizzling butter on top.

name: TRADITIONAL ASHURE (NOAH'S PUDDING)
ingredients: 2 cups wheat, 1 cup chickpeas, 1 cup beans, dried apricots, figs, raisins, sugar, walnuts, pomegranate seeds
preparation: Boil grains and legumes separately. Combine in a large pot with sugar and dried fruits. Cook until thick. Garnish with nuts and pomegranate. Symbolizing diversity and abundance.

name: SPICY RAW MEATBALLS (ETLİ ÇİĞ KÖFTE)
ingredients: 2 cups extra fine bulgur, 200g lean double-ground beef, isot, pepper paste, onion, garlic, fresh parsley
preparation: Knead the bulgur with meat and isot for at least 1 hour using a special tray until the meat 'cooks' in the spice and friction. Add herbs and shape by hand. Serve immediately with lettuce.

name: BLACK SEA ANCHOVY PILAF (HAMSİLİ PİLAF)
ingredients: 500g anchovies (boneless), 1.5 cups rice, onions, pine nuts, currants, dry mint
preparation: Prepare a half-cooked spicy rice. Line a baking dish with anchovies, skin side down. Fill with rice and cover with more anchovies. Bake until the fish is crispy. Flip onto a plate to serve.

name: STUFFED ONIONS (SOGAN DOLMASI)
ingredients: 4 large white onions, 200g ground beef, 1/2 cup rice, sumac, pomegranate molasses, butter
preparation: Boil onions and separate the layers. Fill each layer with the meat and rice mixture. Roll them up. Simmer in a sauce of pomegranate molasses and sumac water until the onions are caramelized and soft.

name: CAULIFLOWER STEAKS
ingredients: 1 large cauliflower, olive oil, garlic powder, smoked paprika, lemon, parsley
preparation: Slice cauliflower into 2cm thick 'steaks'. Brush with oil and spices. Roast at 200C until edges are charred and the center is tender. A modern plant-based alternative that looks impressive.

name: LOBSTER THERMIDOR
ingredients: 2 lobster tails, 1/2 cup heavy cream, egg yolk, dry mustard, parmesan, white wine, shallots
preparation: Cook lobster meat and cube it. Make a rich sauce with cream, wine, mustard, and yolk. Stuff the lobster shells with meat and sauce. Top with parmesan and broil until golden.

name: TRADITIONAL TURKISH HALVA (IRMİK HELVASI)
ingredients: 2 cups semolina, 1 cup butter, 2 cups milk, 1.5 cups sugar, pine nuts
preparation: Toast semolina and pine nuts in butter until golden brown. Pour in the hot milk and sugar mixture. Cover and let it rest until the semolina absorbs all the liquid. Serve warm with ice cream inside.

name: CHICKEN TOPKAPI
ingredients: 4 chicken thighs (deboned), spicy rice with currants and nuts, butter, tomato paste
preparation: Stuff the deboned thighs with the prepared spicy rice. Secure with toothpicks or string. Brush with tomato paste and butter. Bake at 190C until the skin is crispy and the filling is steamed.

name: CIRCASSIAN CHICKEN (CERKEZ TAVUGU)
ingredients: 1 whole chicken (boiled and shredded), 2 cups walnuts, 3 slices of stale bread, garlic, paprika oil
preparation: Crush walnuts and bread into a paste. Mix with chicken broth and garlic. Fold in the shredded chicken. Top with a generous amount of red paprika oil. A cold, creamy, and nutty appetizer.

name: LIVER TAVA (EDİRNE CİĞERİ)
ingredients: 500g calf liver (sliced paper-thin), flour, salt, sunflower oil, dried fried peppers
preparation: Coat the thin liver slices in flour and shake off the excess. Deep fry in very hot oil for only 1 minute so it stays tender. Serve with crunchy dried fried chilies.

name: SUTLU NURIYE (MILKY BAKLAVA)
ingredients: Baklava phyllo, hazelnuts, butter, Syrup: 3 cups milk, 2 cups sugar
preparation: Layer phyllo with butter and crushed hazelnuts. Bake until golden. Unlike regular baklava, pour a cold milk-based syrup over it. It is lighter and has a distinctive white color.

name: ARTICHOKES WITH OLIVE OIL (ZEYTİNYAĞLI ENGINAR)
ingredients: 6 artichoke bottoms, 1 cup peas, 1 carrot, 1 potato, lemon, olive oil, fresh dill
preparation: Cook artichokes in water with lemon and oil. Sauté diced vegetables and place them inside the artichoke cups. Simmer until tender. Serve cold with lots of dill. A peak example of Aegean cuisine.

name: STUFFED LAMB RIBS (KABURGA DOLMASI)
ingredients: Lamb ribs, spicy rice (ic pilav), butter, pepper paste, thyme
preparation: Stuff the space between the rib and the meat with rice. Sew the opening. Steam for 4 hours, then roast in the oven with pepper paste for a crispy finish. Usually served for special guests.

name: POCHED PEARS IN RED WINE
ingredients: 4 pears, 2 cups red wine, 1 cinnamon stick, 3 cloves, 1/2 cup sugar
preparation: Peel pears but leave stems. Simmer in wine, sugar, and spices until tender and deep purple. Reduce the liquid to a syrup and pour over the pears. Serve with mascarpone.

name: TRADITIONAL BEYRAN SOUP
ingredients: Lamb neck meat, 1 cup boiled rice, tallow, garlic, plenty of chili flakes, lamb broth
preparation: In a small copper plate, melt tallow and add garlic and flakes. Add rice and shredded lamb. Pour boiling broth over and bring to a rapid boil on a high flame. An Gaziantep breakfast legend.

name: BEEF CARPACCIO
ingredients: Very thin raw beef tenderloin, arugula, parmesan shavings, capers, olive oil, lemon juice
preparation: Arrange beef slices on a plate. Season with salt and pepper. Top with arugula, parmesan, and capers. Drizzle with high-quality olive oil and lemon. A classic high-end Italian appetizer.

name: QUINOA AND KALE SALAD
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa, 1 bunch kale, cranberries, pumpkin seeds, lemon-tahini dressing
preparation: Massage kale with salt to soften. Mix with cooked quinoa, seeds, and fruit. Toss with a creamy tahini and lemon dressing. A modern superfood-heavy recipe.

name: TRADITIONAL KESKEK
ingredients: 1 kg wheat, 500g lamb meat, butter, paprika
preparation: Slow cook wheat and meat together for 6-8 hours until they blend into a thick, porridge-like consistency. Beat with a large wooden spoon to 'whip' the fibers together. Top with sizzling paprika butter.

name: OCTOPUS SALAD
ingredients: 1 octopus, vinegar, bay leaves, red onion, parsley, olive oil, lemon
preparation: Boil octopus with vinegar and herbs until tender. Slice into bite-sized pieces. Mix with chopped onions and parsley. Marinate in oil and lemon for at least 4 hours.

name: CELERY ROOT WITH ORANGE JUICE
ingredients: 2 celery roots, 1 onion, 1 cup orange juice, 1 carrot, olive oil
preparation: Sauté onions and carrots. Add cubed celery root and fresh orange juice. Simmer until the celery is buttery soft. The orange provides a unique sweetness to this healthy root vegetable.

name: MOTHERS STYLE POTATO MEATBALLS (SULU KOFTE)
ingredients: 300g ground beef, 1/2 cup fine bulgur, 2 potatoes, 1 onion, 1 tbsp tomato paste, dried mint, lemon juice
preparation: Knead meat, grated onion, and bulgur into tiny balls. Sauté tomato paste and cubed potatoes. Add water and bring to a boil. Drop the meatballs in and simmer until the potatoes are soft. Finish with a squeeze of lemon and mint. The ultimate childhood comfort soup.

name: CLASSIC TRAY BOREK (ANNE BOREGI)
ingredients: 5 phyllo sheets (yufka), 2 eggs, 1 cup milk, 1/2 cup yogurt, 1/2 cup oil, Feta cheese and parsley filling
preparation: Whisk eggs, milk, yogurt, and oil for the sauce. Layer yufka in a tray, drenching each layer with the sauce. Spread cheese filling in the middle. Top with more soaked yufka. Bake at 180C until the top is golden and the texture is soft and puffy.

name: STUFFED PEPPERS WITH OLIVE OIL (ZEYTINYAGLI DOLMA)
ingredients: 10 green bell peppers, 1 cup rice, 2 onions, 1 tbsp pine nuts, 1 tbsp currants, cinnamon, allspice, olive oil
preparation: Sauté onions with nuts and currants. Add rice and spices with a little water. Fill the peppers loosely. Arrange in a pot, add water and a generous amount of olive oil. Simmer with a plate on top until the rice is tender. Best served cold.

name: WALNUT STREUSEL COFFEE CAKE
ingredients: 2 cups flour, 1 cup sugar, 2 eggs, 1/2 cup sour cream, Topping: 1/2 cup walnuts, 1 tsp cinnamon, brown sugar
preparation: Mix the cake batter and pour into a pan. Sprinkle a thick layer of crushed walnuts, cinnamon, and sugar on top. Bake until a toothpick comes out clean. A classic 'weekend morning' recipe from mothers around the world.

name: GRANDMAS CHICKEN AND RICE (TAVUKLU PILAV)
ingredients: 1 whole chicken, 2 cups baldo rice, 3 cups chicken broth, butter, lots of black pepper
preparation: Boil the chicken until it falls off the bone; shred the meat. Sauté rice in butter, add the hot chicken broth, and cook until water is absorbed. Top the rice with a mountain of shredded chicken and plenty of black pepper. The smell of a Sunday family lunch.

name: EGGPLANT MUSAKKA (EV USULU)
ingredients: 3 eggplants, 250g ground beef, 2 green peppers, 1 onion, tomato paste, garlic
preparation: Peel eggplants in a zebra pattern, slice and fry them (or brush with oil and bake for a lighter version). Sauté meat with vegetables and paste. Layer eggplants in a dish, top with the meat mix. Add a little water and bake or simmer until flavors meld.

name: LEMONY CHICKEN ORZO SOUP (SEHRIYE CORBASI)
ingredients: 1/2 cup orzo (sehriye), 1 chicken breast, 1 egg yolk, juice of 1 lemon, fresh parsley
preparation: Boil and shred chicken. Cook orzo in the broth. Whisk egg yolk and lemon juice (terbiye), slowly temper with hot broth and pour back into the pot. Garnish with parsley. The go-to recipe for when anyone in the house feels sick.

name: HOMEMADE FIG BARS (ANNE KURABIYESI)
ingredients: 250g butter, 1 cup sugar, 1 egg, 3 cups flour, Filling: 10 dried figs, walnuts, cinnamon
preparation: Cook chopped figs with a little water and sugar until it becomes a paste. Mix the dough and roll it out. Spread the fig paste, roll into a log, and slice. Bake until pale golden. These cookies stay fresh for a week in a tin box.

name: GREEN BEANS IN OLIVE OIL (TAZE FASULYE)
ingredients: 500g green beans, 1 onion, 2 tomatoes, 1 tsp sugar, 1/2 cup olive oil, garlic
preparation: Clean and snap the beans. Place them in a pot with raw chopped onions, tomatoes, garlic, sugar, and oil. Do not add water; let them cook in their own juices over very low heat for 45 minutes until they are soft and vibrant.

name: CLASSIC APPLE PIE
ingredients: Pie crust, 5 apples (peeled and sliced), 1/2 cup sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon, 1 tbsp butter
preparation: Toss apples with sugar and cinnamon. Fill the crust and top with a lattice pattern of dough. Bake at 190C until the crust is flaky and the filling is bubbling. Every mother's secret recipe for a cozy afternoon.

name: CREAMY RICE PUDDING (ANNE SUTLACI)
ingredients: 1 quart milk, 1/2 cup rice, 1.5 cups sugar, 1 tbsp rice flour, vanilla
preparation: Boil rice in water until very soft. Add milk and sugar. Mix rice flour with a little cold milk and stir in to thicken. Simmer until creamy. Unlike the baked version, this is served chilled in glass bowls with a sprinkle of cinnamon.

name: LADYFINGER COCOA CAKE (MOZAIK PASTA)
ingredients: 300g tea biscuits (petibor), 1/2 cup butter, 1/2 cup cocoa, 1/2 cup sugar, 1 cup milk
preparation: Melt butter and mix with milk, sugar, and cocoa. Break the biscuits into small pieces into the mixture (don't crush them). Pour onto plastic wrap, shape into a pyramid or log, and freeze for 3 hours. Slice and serve cold.

name: SHEPARDS PIE
ingredients: 500g ground lamb or beef, 1 cup peas and carrots, 4 large potatoes (mashed with butter and milk)
preparation: Cook the meat with vegetables in a savory gravy. Place in a baking dish. Spread a thick layer of creamy mashed potatoes on top. Score with a fork and bake until the potato peaks are golden brown.

name: BRAISED LEEK WITH CARROTS (ZEYTINYAGLI PIRASA)
ingredients: 4 large leeks, 2 carrots, 1/4 cup rice, juice of 1 orange, olive oil
preparation: Slice leeks and carrots. Sauté carrots in oil, add leeks and rice. Pour orange juice and a little water over them. Simmer until the rice is cooked. The orange juice is the 'mother's touch' that makes this dish sweet and delicious.

name: MOTHERS MEATBALLS (ANNE KOFTE)
ingredients: 500g ground beef, 1 onion, 1 egg, 1/2 cup breadcrumbs, cumin, black pepper, parsley
preparation: Knead all ingredients thoroughly. Shape into small oval patties. Fry in a shallow pan with a little oil. Always served with fried potatoes and sliced tomatoes. The most requested dinner by kids everywhere.
